verses.text: A psalm of David. I will sing about your faithful love and justice. LORD, I will sing praises to you.
I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will live in my own house with a blameless heart.
I will not look at anything shameful. I hate what unfaithful people do. I will have nothing to do with it.
I will keep away from a twisted heart. I will have nothing to do with evil.
I will silence anyone who secretly tells lies about a neighbour. I will not put up with anyone who has proud eyes and a proud heart.
I will look for faithful people in the land, so they can live with me. Those who live blameless lives will serve me.
No one who cheats will live in my house. No one who tells lies will stay in my presence.
Every morning I will silence all the wicked in the land. I will remove every evil person from the city of the LORD.
